sourceClaims.claim: Status.svg fixes 30px pill geometry and observed paint pairs
repeated pairs form reusable paint families without universal meanings
visible text and consumer context own meaning; role=status is not implicit
six semantic foreground corrections improve active-text contrast while source colors, all backgrounds and the three compliant foregrounds remain unchanged

evidence.source-integrity: pass: raw Status.svg geometry and paint families are asserted without semantic renaming
evidence.structural-contract: pass: shared guard classifies every executable and live Status root
evidence.runtime-browser: not-applicable: Status is a static textual primitive and application rendering owns changes
evidence.accessibility: pass: all nine paints exceed 4.5:1 across four supported surfaces; labels remain unfocusable text without implicit live regions or color-only meaning
evidence.focused-visual: pass: independent literal foreground/background expectations cover all nine modifiers; focused paint snapshot preserves hue families and geometry
evidence.consumer-integration: pass: Data Workspace filters rows by visible status text while Status paint remains intentionally consumer-neutral
evidence.responsive-content-stress: pass: long text remains component-bounded in a narrow table cell

staticVisual: pass: original source paints and documented semantic production foregrounds remain distinct static evidence
realInteractionVisual: not-applicable: Status is static text with no hover, focus, active or disabled interaction contract
runtimeBehavior: not-applicable: Status exposes no action, event, navigation or controller behavior

interactionEvidence.manualStateWalk: pass: paint matrix, long label, narrow table cell and Data Workspace filtering inspected; pointer/keyboard states are not meaningful

findings.description: The six formerly failing production foregrounds now use explicit semantic corrections; all nine paints reach at least 4.780:1 across supported surfaces while original source paints remain intact.

knownLimitations: domain status-to-paint mapping and live announcements are consumer-owned
custom foregrounds and unsupported surfaces require consumer contrast validation; this episode certifies Chromium only
